s: Mi sheyyatza im motzi acherim, ubo z' seipim: al kol perot ushear okalim chutz mippat, vekol mashqin chutz miyyayin, im haokelim o hashshotim hem shenayim o yoter — echad mebarek lekullam, ap al pi shello hesebbu al hammittot. Vaapillu bimehem shello haya qeba lisuda belo hasibba, im hem orechim hassoadim etzel baal habbayit vekol echad shulchan qatan lepanayv sheenam yodeim qebiutam yachad ad shehesebbu yachad, vekol zeman shello niqbeu yachad en echad poter et chabero bebirkato bepat veyayin shehem chashubim vedarkam liqboa alehem bahasibba mippene chashibutam, mikkol maqom, bishar debarim sheenan chashubim kol kak veen darkam kol kak bahasibba — poter echad et chabero belo hasibba. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyihyu qebuim yachad bishiba velo baamida. Ubazzeman hazzeh sheen darkenu bahasibba kelal — en chilluq ben pat veyayin lishar debarim, shebbelo yeshiba gam bishar debarim eno poter, ubishiba gam bepat veyayin poter. Vehu sheyyashebu kullam beshulchan echad, o belo shulchan bemappa achat bidbarim shedderek qebiut akilatam hi al hammappa, udebarim shedderek liqboa alehen ap belo mappa, kegon yayin vekayyotze bo, mishsheyyashebu biqbiut yachad al hassapsalim o al haqqatedraot zeh etzel zeh — zo hi qebiutam, abal lo kesheyyashebu zeh bekoh vezeh bekoh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyen hareshut, abal beyen qiddush vehabdala — poter echad et chabero apillu baamida. Vaapillu en omedim bemaqom echad, ella kol echad bebeto, sheechad meqaddesh o mabdil bebeto umitkavven lehotzi shekeno, ushekeno shomea al hakkos shebbeyado veshoteh, hoil vehi choba, veenah kebirkat hannehenin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ra"g. Vaapillu im kebar taam hamqaddesh o hammabdil kimlo lugmayv, veshub en hashshomeim tzerikim litom ella lemitzva min hammubchar — ap al pi ken niptarim bebirkato apillu baamida, shemmittok shehem mitztorpim yachad latzet yede qiddush vehabdala — mitztorpim gam ken latzet yede birkat hayyayin. Veyesh omerim shebbishar debarim chutz mippat veyayin en echad poter et chabero vaapillu hesebbu, shekkevan sheen darkam liqboa alehem kol kak — en qebiut moelet bahem, ella im ken bau betok hasseuda, shemmittok shemmoelet qebiut lehappat — moelet gam ken lishar debarim. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara harishona, nahagu bimdinot ellu lebarek kol echad leatzmo bishar debarim lachosh lassebara haacharona, chutz mishshekar ume debash, lepi shergilin liqboa alehem ap belo seuda, lepikak moelet bahem qebiut kemo beyayin. Umikkol maqom, ap beyayin, im shenayim o shelosha niknasim lebet adam echad venotenim lahem yayin lishtot derek aray — kol echad mebarek leatzmo, apillu yoshebim beshulchan echad, sheen echad poter chabero bekol haddebarim ella bishibat qeba al daat shello laaqor miyyad mimmaqom zeh apillu lelek liqboa bemaqom acher, veen tzarik lomar im en datam liqboa kelal, ella lishtot bederek aray:

Vekol zeh bibraka rishona, sheddatam lehitchabber veliqboa atzman leekol velishtot yachad — hare qebiutam zo metzaraptam lehechasheb kegup echad, uberaka achat lekullam, abal babberaka haacharona, kevan shekkebar akelu vehem mitpordim zeh mizzeh — enan mitztorpim zeh im zeh lehechasheb kegup echad, vetzarik lebarek kol echad beatzmo al hanaat gupo. Velo ameru sheyyebarek echad lekullam, ella bepat shemmebarekim aleha birkat hammazon, velo bishar berakot acharonot sheenan chashubot kebirkat hammazon lomar alehem "nebarek" battechilla. Umikkol maqom, bediabad shebberak echad venitkavven lehotzi hashshomeim vehem nitkavvenu latzet yede chobatam — yatzeu, im hayu qebuim baakilatam qebiut hammoelet letzorpam libraka rishona. Veim echad eno yodea lebarek beatzmo — yotze lekattechilla bebirkat chabero sheqqaba immo. Veakshav shehehamon mezalzelim meod bibraka acharona — yesh laasot ken lekattechilla, sheyyebarek echad beqol ram lehotzi kol hashshomeim, ap al pi sheyyodeim lebarek beatzman:

Kebar nitbaer besiman qs"z shebbirkat hannehenin eno yakol lebarek lehotzi chabero yede chobato ella im ken gam hu chayyab bibraka zo, ben shehi beraka rishona, o apillu beraka acharona, mittaam shennitbaer besiman qtz"z. Vaapillu bediabad, im mi shello nitchayyeb bibraka zo berak lehotzi hashshomeim, ap al pi shennitkavvenu latzet bishmiatam vegam anu "amen" — lo yatzeu, sheap shehashshomea keoneh, mikkol maqom, kevan shebbirkato hayeta lebattala — hare lo shameu beraka haguna:

En adam yotze yede chobato bishmiat habberaka apillu ana "amen", ella im ken shemaah mittechillatah vead sopah venitkavven latzet bah yede chobato vehambarek nitkavven lehotzio. Veaz yotze yede chobato bediabad apillu lo ana "amen". (Uledibre haomerim shemmitzvot shel dibrehem en tzerikim kavvana, ap al pi shello nitkavven hambarek lehotzio vegam hu lo nitkavven latzet bah — yatza, ben bibraka acharona ben bibraka rishona, kegon mi shennatal peri beyado leoklo, o mitzva laasoto, veqodem shehispiq lebarek shama beraka zo mippi acher hambarek leatzmo — en tzarik lebarek. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem velizzaher shello likkanes bispeq beraka lebattala):

Lo hitzriku sheyyihyu hambarek vehashshomeim qebuim yachad bishiba ella bahanaat akila ushetiyya, shekkol echad nehena bipne atzmo, abal bemugmar shekkullam nehenim beyachad mehareach haoleh mimmennu — poter echad et chabero apillu baamida, vaapillu enan qebuim bemaqom echad, ella zeh bekoh vezeh bekoh. Veken bebirkat haur bemotzae shabbat. (Veod, shebbirkat haur enah kebirkat hannehenin mammash, ki hi hanaa keen choba. Umittaam zeh gam bebirkat hareach shebbemotzae shabbat poter echad et chabero shello biqbiut yeshiba, apillu merichim zeh achar zeh, vaapillu shello bishat habdala):

Kol maqom sheechad poter et chabero bebirkat hannehenin mippene qebiutam yachad, o mippene shennehenim beyachad — mitzva sheechad yebarek lekullam velo kol echad leatzmo, shenneemar "berab am hadrat melek". Abal bebirkat hammitzvot, im kol echad oseh mitzva bipne atzmo, ap shekkullan mitzva achat, kegon shekkol echad mitattep betzitzit o lobesh tepillin — hareshut beyadam, im ratzu — echad mebarek lekullam, kede leqayyem "berab am hadrat melek", veim ratzu — kol echad mebarek leatzmo (kede leharbot babberakot, ki leolam yarbeh adam babberakot hatztzerikot. Veap shehashshomea keoneh, mikkol maqom, hambarek hu iqqar, shehu naasa shaliach lekullam lehotziam yede chobatan, vekullam meqayyemim mitzvat habberaka al yado, ukeillu kullam mebarekim beraka achat hayyotze mippi hambarek, sheppiv kepihem, verauy yoter sheyyeqayyem kol echad veechad beatzmo mitzvat habberaka mishsheyyeqayyemenna al yede shaliach, shekkevan shekkol echad chayyab bibraka zo leatzmo — hare zeh ribbuy berakot hatztzerikot, veenam domot kelal lachazarat hashsheliach tzibbur ulebirkat hazzimmun, shennitbaer besiman qtz"b. Mah sheen ken bebirkot hannehenin, keshekkullan qebuim yachad shehem nechshabim kegup echad neheneh, velaken day lahem bibraka achat, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z, im ken im yebareku kol echad leatzmo — enan berakot hatztzerikot kelal, kevan shehanaat kullam nechshebet kahanaat gup echad al yede qebiatam yachad, ella im ken techillat qebiutam hayeta al daat shello lehitztarep libraka achat, sheaz naasa keillu lo niqbeu kelal yachad, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g) . Abal kesheqqabeu atzman setam — naasu kegup echad, veen maala kol kak beribbuy habberakot. Veap sheen bazeh issur beraka sheenah tzerika, kevan shekkol echad chayyab bibraka zo, vegam akshav sheshshomeim hem keonim, mikkol maqom, kevan sheen maala beribbuy habberakot — tzarik sheyyebarek echad, leqayyem "berab am veku'". Veken keshekkullam nehenim beyachad — day bibraka achat lekullam, ap al pi shello niqbeu yachad, veen maala kol kak beribbuy habberakot. Vehu haddin bebirkot hammitzvot keshekkullam meqayyemim hammitzva beyachad, kegon shemiat qol shopar o megilla — mitzva sheechad mebarek lekullam, ben hattoqea o haqqore, ben echad min hashshomeim. Veken im yoshebim besukka achat. Abal im ratzu leqayyem kol echad hammitzva bipne atzmo ulebarek leatzman — hareshut beyadam, kegon sheyyiqra kol echad hammegilla leatzmo im en sham asara, o sheyyitqa leatzmo. Umikkol maqom, tob sheyyiqra echad lekullam, leqayyem "berab am hadrat melek", ap al pi sheen chiyyub baddabar, sheen lechayyeb adam sheyyeqayyem hammitzva hammuttelet alayv al yede shaliach kesheyyakol leqayyemah beatzmo. Veken beqiddush vehabdala, vekol kayyotze bahen:

Vekol zeh keshekkol echad meqayyem mitzva shelema, abal im ben kullam naaset mitzva achat shelema — echad mebarek lekullam bekol inyan, veen rashshaim lebarek kol echad leatzmo, kegon bene beto shel baal habbayit shebbodeqin et hechametz bachadar habbayit, shello nishlema hammitzva velo yatza yede chobat biur chametz ad sheyyebaarennu mikkol chadarayv. (Vaapillu rabbim sheosim mitzva achat shelema leadam echad shekkullan muttalot alayv choba, kegon shemmaprishin challa meissotayv, o qobeim mezuzot biptachayv, o malin et banayv beshaa achat — en rashshaim lechalleq, ella tzerikin laasot beyachad, kede sheyyebarek echad lekullam, shekkevan shello yatza yede chobat mitzva zo ad sheyyaaseh kullam — hare lo nigmar hammitzva ad sheyyaaseh kullam, velaken day bibraka achat, veasur ligrom beraka sheenah tzerika). (Abal im malin b' tinoqot shel b' bene adam — rashshaim lechalleq ulemulam bazeh achar zeh ulebarek kol echad leatzmo. Venakon laasot ken, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea):
